title: UAP craft manipulate a subquantum information domain (Frieden's Fisher information)

tellings.quote: >> Right. I think what's happening is is I think the UAP craft are manipulating the uh the information domain because I think that there's a subquantum domain of information.

plain: The researcher Eric W. Davis, introduced on the show as a Pentagon scientist, tells Michels he thinks UAP craft (UAP, "unidentified anomalous phenomena", is the official term for UFOs) work by "manipulating the information domain", because he believes there is "a subquantum domain of information" beneath ordinary physics. He builds the idea on work by Roy Frieden of the University of Arizona about Fisher information, a statistical measure of how much information a measurement carries, and he names Frieden's two books from Cambridge University Press and a New Scientist article on the subject. If he is right, these craft would be steering reality at a level below quantum physics.
